records.question: What happens if a lot of people bring the same dispute against Discord at once?
records.text:
Quote: You agree that any Dispute between you and Discord that for any reason is not subject to the “Agreement to Arbitrate” section below may only be pursued by you on an individual basis, and you may not bring a claim as a plaintiff or a class member in a class, collective, or representative action. [Discord – Settling disputes between you and Discord]
Quote: IF YOU’RE A U.S. RESIDENT, EXCEPT AS PROVIDED HEREIN, UNLESS DISCORD AGREES OTHERWISE IN A SEPARATE WRITING, YOU AND DISCORD AGREE THAT EACH MAY BRING CLAIMS AGAINST THE OTHER ONLY IN OUR INDIVIDUAL CAPACITY, AND NOT AS A PLAINTIFF OR CLASS MEMBER IN ANY PURPORTED CLASS OR REPRESENTATIVE PROCEEDING AND THE ARBITRATOR MAY AWARD RELIEF ONLY IN FAVOR OF THE INDIVIDUAL PARTY SEEKING RELIEF AND ONLY TO THE EXTENT NECESSARY TO RESOLVE AN INDIVIDUAL PARTY’S CLAIM. [Discord – Settling disputes between you and Discord]
Quote: This subsection does not prevent you or Discord from participating in a class-wide settlement of claims. [Discord – Settling disputes between you and Discord]

Answer: If a Dispute is not subject to the "Agreement to Arbitrate," it may only be pursued by an individual, and you cannot bring a claim as a plaintiff or a class member in a class, collective, or representative action [Discord – Settling disputes between you and Discord]. For U.S. residents, claims must generally be brought in an individual capacity, and the arbitrator may only award relief to the individual party seeking relief to the extent necessary to resolve that individual's claim [Discord – Settling disputes between you and Discord]. However, this does not prevent participation in a class-wide settlement of claims [Discord – Settling disputes between you and Discord].
cited_labels: [Discord – Settling disputes between you and Discord]
